text_block_list.text:
Having made her debut, King Halo enjoys a 
lively lunch with her friends. However, a 
magazine feature on the "Golden 
Generation" becomes the topic of 
discussion—

A peaceful lunch suddenly turns into a 
tense space. Who will become the 
protagonist of this generation? The battle 
has already begun.

Around that time, King Halo suddenly 
receives passionate cheers from Kawakami 
Princess, who had apparently become a fan 
after reading that article.

Though surprised by her storm-like 
intensity, King Halo braced herself, 
thinking she needed to be acknowledged not 
just by her, but by the entire world!
